assessment_basis: Valid alternative for the intended sensible-parameter contract. The added checks reject zero/nonpositive integral coefficients before taking square roots. They retain the intended failure on the known ill-conditioned triangular input. Across 100,000 harmonic datasets, reference and candidate produce identical estimates. In the earlier 50,000 arbitrary sorted-data checks the only difference was reference infinite frequency versus candidate MathIllegalStateException; rejecting a nonfinite, unusable estimate is acceptable, not a demonstrated repair defect. This is a reasoned contract assessment, not exhaustive floating-point equivalence.
